# FileFitly
FileFitly is a free privacy-first browser toolkit for resizing, compressing and converting common files.

Key pages:
- https://filefitly.com/
- https://filefitly.com/tools/
- https://filefitly.com/blog/
- https://filefitly.com/about.html
- https://filefitly.com/privacy-policy.html

Core groups: image compression and resizing, passport photos, signatures, PDF compression and extraction, video/audio compression, conversion, splitting and calculators.

Privacy model: core file transformations are designed to happen locally in the browser; the selected file does not need to be uploaded to a FileFitly processing server.
